primary_findings.finding: Explicitly warns that analytic phase derivative may be negative whereas a positive TFD with exact marginals cannot have negative conditional mean frequency. Universal IF impossibility is prior art.
Nonnegativity plus marginals implies strong finite support; Cohen-Posch family reproduced as equations (3)-(6).
Unequal two-tone phase IF leaves the spectral range; a phase derivative is not in general a positive conditional average.
Finite-first-moment convex order iff a martingale coupling; explicitly attributed to Strassen.

The author regards adaptive positive TFDs as high-quality time-varying energy representations. This is a viewpoint, not an existence theorem for exact IF/GD. It cautions against equating IF failure with failure of every physical interpretation.
